title: Running Spark on Kubernetes and on managed services

videos.script: A data job no longer has to own a cluster. On Kubernetes, Spark is one more thing the cluster runs: the driver is a pod, and it asks the cluster for executor pods of its own. {{k8s}} This lesson shows how that is set up, and says plainly that it could not be run on the machine it was recorded on. {{honest}} What it does run is the half that matters everywhere. Executors that arrive when there is work and leave when there is none, and the shuffle files that keep them from leaving. {{dynamic}} A client with no Java in it, sending plans to a Spark Connect server. {{connect}} And the managed services, which run all of this for you and bill by the hour. {{managed}}
